headline: India's prime minister is wooing the Gen Z while cracking down on them
context: Over two months, protesters, most who appeared to be digitally-savvy GenZ, used social media to organize. Government's efforts to respond spotlight how the ruling party appears to be playing catch-up.

sources.name: NPR
